title: Dual DNF preserves within-clause variable-distinctness
statement: Let $\psi$ be a CNF formula on $n$ variables with the property that, within each of its clauses, any two literals having the same variable are in fact the same literal (so no variable occurs in a clause with both polarities, nor is any literal repeated). Then the De Morgan dual DNF obtained from $\psi$ by negating every literal has the same property term by term: within each of its terms, any two literals sharing a variable are equal.
hypotheses_covered: ψ is a CNF formula on n variables
within every clause of ψ, any two literals with equal variable are equal
replaced:
If within each clause of $\psi$ any two literals with the same variable are equal,
then the same holds within every term of $\mathrm{cnfToDualDNF}\,\psi$.
